Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Guinness Ghana DJ Awards takes All Out Rave to KNUST, draws over 10,000 ravers Source : Merqury Quaye 19 October 2026 4:04pm Audio By Carbonatix
The Guinness Ghana DJ Awards brought its ALL OUT RAVE experience to the Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), delivering an electrifying celebration of music, nightlife and DJ culture at Republic Hall.
Powered by Smirnoff, with sponsorship from Fiesta Condoms and Eden Gardens Hotel, the event attracted more than 10,000 ravers, transforming Republic Hall into a vibrant party destination filled with music, energy and excitement.
The night saw DJs Safety, Qwerty DJ, DJ Fabian, DJ Phuture and DJ Kveb take turns behind the decks, delivering energetic sets that kept the crowd moving and showcased the power of DJs to bring people together through music.
The excitement was amplified by MCs Juicy Jay, Kevin K, Dangote, Presido and GAB, who kept the audience engaged and sustained the high-energy atmosphere throughout the event.
Among the notable personalities in attendance were Guinness Ghana DJ Awards founder and festival producer Merqury Quaye, celebrated Ghanaian musician Okyeame Kwame, and MC Portfolio.
The massive turnout highlighted the enthusiasm of the KNUST student community for live entertainment and DJ culture, with the ALL OUT RAVE providing a platform for students and music lovers to connect through a shared passion for music.
The event forms part of the broader Guinness Ghana DJ Awards experience, which continues to extend its reach beyond the annual awards ceremony through activations that celebrate DJs, engage audiences and promote Ghana’s vibrant music culture.
With its ALL OUT theme, the awards is building momentum towards the grand finale scheduled for December 4, 2026, bringing the DJ community and music lovers together in a celebration of the people behind the sounds that move Ghana.
Joy Prime, the event’s media partner, continues to support the awards’ mission to amplify Ghanaian DJ culture and bring its experiences to wider audiences.
The KNUST edition of ALL OUT RAVE added another exciting chapter to the awards season, proving that when the music starts, the crowd is ready to go ALL OUT.
